name: Zedekiah
summary: The last king of Judah, whom the king of Babylon set on the throne and renamed from Mattaniah. He did evil, rebelled against Babylon, and would not obey the word of the LORD through Jeremiah, so he saw Jerusalem fall.

key_moments.title: Made King by Babylon
key_moments.description: Babylon's king put Mattaniah on the throne and renamed him Zedekiah. He ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years, did evil in the LORD's eyes, and turned against Babylon.

key_moments.title: Hands Jeremiah Over
key_moments.description: The princes asked for Jeremiah to be killed for what he was saying. Zedekiah said the prophet was in their hands, and they let Jeremiah down by cords into a muddy dungeon.

key_moments.title: Meets Jeremiah in Secret
key_moments.description: Zedekiah brought Jeremiah to him in secret and swore not to kill him. Jeremiah told him that if he went out to the princes of Babylon he would live and the city would not be burned, but Zedekiah was afraid.

key_moments.title: Captured on the Plains
key_moments.description: When the city was broken into, Zedekiah fled by night but was caught in the plains of Jericho. At Riblah the king of Babylon killed his sons before his eyes, then blinded him and chained him to be taken to Babylon.
